old: match &clip.payload { TimelineClipPayload::TransformProperty { property, keys } => { ui.separator(); ui.strong(format!("Curve: {property}")); let mut edited = keys.clone(); let mut changed = false; for key in &mut edited { ui.horizontal(|ui| { let mut local = seconds(key.tick); if ui.add(egui::DragValue::new(&mut local).range(0.0..=seconds(clip.duration)).speed(0.01).suffix(" s")).changed() { key.tick = tick(local).clamp(TimelineTick::ZERO, clip.duration); changed = true; } changed |= curve_value_ui(ui, &mut key.value); }); } if changed { edited.sort_by_key(|key| key.tick); command = Some(TimelineAuthoringCommand::SetClipPayload { clip: clip.id.clone(), payload: TimelineClipPayload::TransformProperty { property: property.clone(), keys: edited } }); } }, TimelineClipPayload::Event { name, payload } => { let mut next_name = name.clone(); let mut next_payload = payload.clone(); if ui.text_edit_singleline(&mut next_name).changed() || ui.text_edit_multiline(&mut next_payload).changed() { command = Some(TimelineAuthoringCommand::SetClipPayload { clip: clip.id.clone(), payload: TimelineClipPayload::Event { name: next_name, payload: next_payload } }); } }, _ => {} }
